finding: setupHarness performs two dynamic import()s of the admin page's module graph INSIDE the test body; first call costs ~3.5s of Vitest's 5000ms default per-test budget, leaving ~1.1s headroom. Under contention the first test times out. Oracle: reproduced as `Test timed out in 5000ms` (1/80 contended runs) and forced deterministically at --testTimeout=2000.

The first test in the file pays a one-time cost its siblings do not (3615ms vs 215ms/135ms), so the suite's slowest test is slow for a reason unrelated to what it asserts. Measured slowest in the entire component suite; next slowest 2007ms.

FB-11 candidate: cfg.loadModules() is fire-and-forget before render. NOT the cause of the file-rag spec failure (that spec never calls mountGallery) and not reproduced via 20 scoped gallery crawls. Left unfixed by DEC-2; the actionable sub-finding is the TYPE: GalleryConfig.loadModules is `() => void` while the app's loadModules is `async (): Promise<void>`, so the race is hidden by the type rather than by the call.

createStoreProxy picks a 0-hook or 2-hook path from the runtime VALUE type, so any state field whose type changes across renders changes a component's hook count. Probed with a positive-controlled instrument over 40 runs: 0 path flips on this surface. Real hazard class, not active here.

appLayoutChrome() is the only surviving seam peek() consumer in the tree; the placeholder is itself a createStoreProxy, so both branches take the identical proxy path. The prior fix's invariant holds and the bug class has no un-migrated sibling.
